summary: Gorax breaks down the Dragon Crown Homage spending event, explaining how the coffer draw mechanics and prize tiers work. He calculates the total Dragon Crystal cost required to reach guaranteed milestone rewards such as the Dark Lady figurine or Legendary Hero collection chests. By stacking the Starlit Delights rebate event alongside double top-up offers, spenders can reduce the effective cash cost from around $600 down to approximately $300. He also advises players to monitor active coffer pools and target ones where top-tier S-prizes have not yet been drawn.
tips: Combine Dragon Crown Homage top-ups with the Starlit Delights rebate event to earn up to 30,000 additional Dragon Crystals.
Target coffers in the event pool where the S-rank prize (such as the Dark Lady figurine) has not yet been claimed to maximize your chances.
If you plan to convert Dragon Crystals into Heliolite Dice for summoning anyway, participating in this event provides extra milestone rewards and bonus items.
